### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s).

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ui/reports.mdx`  _(via fileNamePrefix (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`  _(via fileNamePrefix (literal, a string literal in sections))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0819cab13c33b6b996c0a5c410052d9524fcf1f7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `52eaf5a20e0882d4a1c5390f74b012b52d07347b` — the merge of head `cf23885ef91081bbd511897baf7b74c561cec8b6` into base `0819cab13c33b6b996c0a5c410052d9524fcf1f7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 52eaf5a20e0882d4a1c5390f74b012b52d07347b && git checkout 52eaf5a20e0882d4a1c5390f74b012b52d07347b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0819cab13c33b6b996c0a5c410052d9524fcf1f7 cf23885ef91081bbd511897baf7b74c561cec8b6 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0819cab13c33b6b996c0a5c410052d9524fcf1f7 && git merge --no-ff cf23885ef91081bbd511897baf7b74c561cec8b6

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0819cab13c33b6b996c0a5c410052d9524fcf1f7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0819cab13c33b6b996c0a5c410052d9524fcf1f7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head cf23885e · 2026-11-24T07:11Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `cf23885ef91081bbd511897baf7b74c561cec8b6`
Card: #36838 (from L1 record 7121034256 on #36814, N1–N4) · claim 7123044139 · os-dev-report 7124023409. Contract review claimed on this head (7124704306) at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (face: `report.form.ts`); the record follows.

### Checklist
- **Shape:** `l1-face` CLEAN, 13 items. Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36838`. `mergeable_state` clean.
- **Checks at this head:** 59 success, 10 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending.
- **Governance:** NOT governed, 89 lines.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. The four rows gain a form `label`, and the two hints change their text. No key, widget, `visibleWhen`, accepted value, default or `.meta` moves.
- **Changeset:** spec and platform-objects (published, src moved), plus app-shell (private, inert), all at patch. The prose is true sentence by sentence:
  - the four labels now equal the blocks grid's titles;
  - the Metrics hint is widened;
  - File Name says the prefix replaces the label, falling back to the name. That is true of `ReportExport.tsx:217`: `buildExportFileName(format, { prefix, label: reportLabel, objectName: name })`, prefix first, then label, then name;
  - the bundles are regenerated, File Name is re-translated in three locales, and the overlay follows the English for Date Range and Runtime Filter.
- **Card Acceptance:**
  - N1: met. The en top-level labels equal the grid's, and the console zh-CN overlay already read 数据来源 / 指标 / 分组 / 列分组 for both positions.
  - N2 and N3: met.
  - N4: met. The overlay `dateRange` and `runtimeFilter` hints follow the English. The date-grouping sentence moved to the `dateRange.dimension` child row, where it already lived.
  - Locale rule: File Name is translated in full. The new en of the `values` hint is left untranslated for #36836, the translator-pass card that already owns that row. The report names this, so it stays in the routed carrier.
- **Ledger:** `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` changes no population count, verdict or translated value. The "Dataset" twin is re-pointed to `en.dataset.label`, with a per-locale assertion, because the en word the heading came from still has a home there. The dataset-panel ledger rows follow the moved hint.
- **Scope:** inside the claim. The `exportOptions.fileNamePrefix` overlay row moved because the file keeps unmarked rows as byte copies of the platform bundle; it is declared.
- **Tests:** platform-objects: 125 files, 2126 tests. spec: 267 files, 9316 tests. 26 UI reader files, 254 tests. `check:generated` up to date. No ablation, because only text and pins moved, which is fine for a text card.

### Findings
Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.
- **N1 (nit):** the report's first out-of-scope finding has no carrier. The platform zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES bundles still give the eight report labels (four top-level rows and their four block twins) the dataset vocabulary (数据集 / 度量 / 行 / 列), while the console overlay reads the new terms. Only the server-served form outside the console shows it. **To the seat:** fold it into #36836, or file a card for it.

### Landing notes
The area lands once this ACCEPT and a PASS contract-review record on this head are both in place. `Fixes #36838` closes the card.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cf23885ef91081bbd511897baf7b74c561cec8b6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts + packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts

Inputs read: card #36838 with its three comments (triage 7121121205, claim 7123044139, dev report 7124023409), PR #36879's body, file list and net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on this head. Every check-run on the head concluded `success` or `skipped`; none failed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — right.** The diff adds a `label` to four existing rows of `reportForm` (`dataset`, `values`, `rows`, `columns`) and rewrites two `helpText` strings (`values`, `exportOptions.fileNamePrefix`). `report.zod.ts` is not in the diff, so no key, type, default, refinement or `.meta({ title })` of `ReportSchema` or `JoinedReportBlockSchema` moves.
- **Form structure: unchanged — right.** No row is added, removed or reordered; no `field`, `widget`, `type`, `visibleWhen`, `required` or section `label` changes. The section titles `Dataset binding` and `Joined blocks`, which slug into catalog keys, are untouched.
- **Published surface: values only — right.** `reportForm` keeps its export and its shape; four `label` strings and two `helpText` strings are new values on it. The CI api-surface and authorable-surface gates are green on the head.
- **Catalog key set: unchanged — right.** `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts:2771` on main emits `metadataForms.report.fields.KEY.label` as `inlineText(field.label) ?? humanizeFieldPath(path)`, so each of the four label leaves already existed with the humanized text. The `en` bundle hunk changes six values and no key. The three translated bundles change one value each (`exportOptions.fileNamePrefix.helpText`).
- **Rendering: the declared label wins — right.** `SchemaForm.tsx:1931-1934` on main resolves `fieldSpec.label`, then the localized schema title, then `prettify(name)`. `ReportSchema` gives these four keys no title (`report.zod.ts:579-596`), so the rows did read the prettified keys, as the new comment says.
- **Blocks-grid terms: match — right.** The four new labels are byte-equal to the blocks rows of the same form (`Data Source`, `Group By`, `Group Columns By`, `Metrics`) and to `JoinedReportBlockSchema`'s titles at `report.zod.ts:440-446`.
- **Fill locales: served correctly — right.** `ar`, `de`, `fr`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru` and `zh-Hant` still hold the old English `fileNamePrefix` hint as a fill. Each carries a provenance entry for that leaf in its `source-hashes.generated.ts`, so the source-hash fallback serves the new English. `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` carry no entry and are re-translated in this diff. The stale-fill gate is green.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/36838-report-form-one-vocabulary.md` takes `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@object-ui/app-shell`. Those are the three packages whose shipped bytes move, and `patch` is the level for a text fix in a released package.
- `Clause-②: no` is right. No accepted set or published type shape changes; only string values on an exported form constant do. The line is present and line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, and it matches the claim.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right. Nothing a metadata author can write is added, refused or given a new meaning or default. It is present in both bodies and matches the claim, and `none` takes `patch`.
- The changeset prose agrees with the tree: the four old and new titles, the two hints, the three re-translated locales and the two zh-CN overlay hints are all as the diff has them.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation, the overlay's `exportOptions.fileNamePrefix` row moved: accepted. That file's header keeps unmarked rows byte copies of the platform zh-CN bundle, and the two values are byte-equal on this head.
- Deviation, the `Dataset` twin assertion in `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` re-pointed: accepted, judged in ④.
- Deviation, `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check left to CI: answered. `Type Check UI` is `success` on the head.
- Deviation, the PR body footer shape: not a contract face, left to the lane seat.
- Out-of-scope finding with no carrier, the platform label translations in the older vocabulary: see N2 in ④. It needs a card.
- Out-of-scope finding carried by #36836: #36836 is an open card in `pm:queue`. It has no claim and no open PR, so no file overlaps today. The `values` hint is one of its rows; this PR moves that row's English and leaves its three translations alone, and the ledger row names #36836. The card must translate against the English on this head, so it is claimed after this PR lands, as the claim comment already orders.
- Not stated as a flag but following from the diff: the server-served form now offers the machine-name hint on these four rows (`SchemaForm.tsx:2044-2051`: the source label no longer equals the prettified key). This is the same rule `Sort Order` already follows. The PR says it was not checked in a browser; no finding.
- SQL push-down: the diff holds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.
- Author: the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no off-relay author note is owed.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`**, against the runtime on main:

- N1 of the card, the four labels: holds. One form now names each key once, and the terms are the schema titles one level down.
- N2 of the card, the `values` hint: holds. `values` selects dataset measures by name (`report.zod.ts:596`). A measure may be an aggregate, `avg` among them, or `derived` with `op: 'ratio'` (`dataset.zod.ts:334`, `:374`). The report viewer draws whichever measures are named (`DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:1165-1196`). "Totals, counts, averages or ratios" is an open list of examples, each of which exists.
- N3 of the card, the `fileNamePrefix` hint: holds. `ReportExport.tsx:210-217` passes the prefix and `pickLocalized(label, language) || name` to `buildExportFileName`. That function (`export-filename.ts:58-77`) takes the sanitized prefix first, else the label, and appends the date and time. So the prefix is the start of the name, and an empty prefix names the file after the label, then the name. The new code comment says the same.
- Tried to break it: a prefix that sanitizes to nothing falls through to the label, which agrees with the hint. The hint's "label" is the label in the viewer's language, which is still the report's label.

**The two ledgers:** consistent with the tree.

- `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` holds each row's `en` equal to the live bundle, and the four moved rows carry the new English. Their reasons were checked against the bundles: the top-level `dataset`, `values` and `rows` labels are byte-identical to their `blocks.*` twins in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES, and the three `values` hint translations say "the measure names to show", which promises no narrower set than the new English. No verdict and no translated value moved.
- `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts`: the re-pointed assertion is sound. The translated `report.fields.dataset.label` values are still asserted, and the English word `Dataset` is now read from `dataset.label`, whose three renderings are asserted equal to them.

**`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`:** the three zh-CN hints say what the current English says. `runtimeFilter` and `dateRange` follow the English at `report.form.ts`, and the date-grouping sentence the old `dateRange` hint carried lives on the `dateRange.dimension` row. `runtimeFilter` is correctly marked hand-worded, because the platform row still holds the older sentence.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits, none of which changes correctness or the contract:

- N1 (nit) — `ReportSchema.label` is required (`report.zod.ts:564`), so the hint's last clause, "or its name when it has no label", describes a state a saved report rarely reaches. It is true of the runtime. Accepted as written.
- N2 (nit) — after this PR the platform zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES labels of these four rows translate the old English (`行`, `Filas` for `Group By`). They are legacy-trusted, so they stay served. Each locale is still one vocabulary inside the form, and the blocks twins were already in this state. The dev report lists it with no carrier. Follow-up card: a translator pass over the eight label leaves, and the platform zh-CN `values` hint, which #36836 does not cover.
- N3 (nit) — the section heading still reads `Dataset binding` above a row titled `Data Source`. Renaming it moves a slugged catalog key, so it is rightly outside this PR. Follow-up card, or fold into N2's.
- N4 (nit) — the `Dataset binding` row in `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` (line 251) still names `report.fields.dataset.label` as the `Dataset` twin without the #36838 note its sibling ledger rows got. The file header and the test comment do carry it. Prose in a test file; accepted as a deviation.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36838-report-form-one-vocabulary`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufziwMkZG34d69p8BHb4` (sub-agent)

**VERDICT: PASS**
